judge.rationale: The candidate implemented the wrong wire protocol names and type names entirely: it used `list_sessions` and `session_list` with `sessions` (`ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionSummaryFrame`, `SessionListMessage`) instead of the issue's explicitly specified `list_conversations` and `conversation_list` with `conversations` (`ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationSummary`, `ConversationListMessage`). It completely omitted the opt-in `HalEngineConfig.transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}` flag, defaulting the feature to always-on. In `validation.ts`, it allowed `limit: 0` and unbounded limits (`limit > 200`), directly violating the acceptance criterion requiring `limit` to be 1–200. Furthermore, it logged `error.message` on store failures (which can leak database credentials), skipped updating `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md` with the new frame definitions, skipped updating `example/full-config.ts` and `docs/getting-started.md`, and left `.lore/dod.md` in the repository.
